title: White Rice with Carrots, Dark Green Vegetables and Tomato‑Based Sauce, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: This dish consists of boiled white rice, sliced carrots, dark green vegetables (such as broccoli or spinach) and tomato sauce or fresh tomatoes. No fat is added, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White rice is one of the most widely consumed grains worldwide.
Carrots are rich in beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
Dark green vegetables contain chlorophyll and high amounts of vitamin K.
Tomato sauce provides lycopene, a powerful antioxidant.
The dish’s lack of added fat preserves the natural taste of the ingredients.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Rice supplies quick‑digesting carbohydrates that fuel the body.

items.title: Eye health
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots and lycopene from tomatoes support visual health.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Dark green vegetables are rich in vitamin K and calcium, important for strong bones.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Lycopene and chlorophyll help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: The absence of added fat makes the meal suitable for low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tomatoes or tomato sauce.

items.title: Low fiber
items.content: Compared with whole‑grain rice, white rice provides less dietary fiber.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish as a side to meat, fish or legumes. It also works well in lunch boxes. If desired, add spices such as turmeric or paprika without using oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared meal in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. Reheat using a microwave or steam to avoid drying out.
